name: James Uthmeier
stance: Seeks court orders barring OpenAI from developing new models without independent third-party safety approval, citing loss-of-control risk, and wants companies criminally liable when their chatbots take part in crimes.

statements.text: This is not just any service. It is one that Defendants themselves concede poses an existential risk to the continued survival of humankind.

Filed a motion for temporary injunction in Florida's Tenth Judicial Circuit (Highlands County) asking the court to bar OpenAI from developing new AI models without independent third-party safety approval and to block Florida minors from ChatGPT.
No new model development without independent safety guardrails, no more harvesting children's data, no more calling this product safe, accurate or reliable.
When a product participates in a crime like that, the company that built it is not a bystander.
Filed the first state lawsuit against OpenAI and CEO Sam Altman (unfair trade practices, negligence, fraudulent misrepresentation, public nuisance), seeking to hold Altman personally liable.
My prosecutors have looked at this and they've told me if it was a person on the other end of that screen we would be charging them with murder.
